import PhaseFirst.Action
namespace PhaseFirst.HeaderDiagnostic
open QleisliKernel QleisliKernel.SourceTypes QleisliKernel.Finite

def originalText := "#![no_implicit_prelude]\npub unitary fn sign(q:Q<Bit>)->Q<Bit>{phase[1,1](q)}"
def controlText := "pub unitary fn sign(q:Q<Bit>)->Q<Bit>{phase[1,1](q)}"

#eval (sourceCatalogue originalText).map fun scanned => scanned.bodies.map fun body =>
  (body.declaration.name,body.header.map (·.text))
#eval ((OrdinarySignature.readOriginalEnvelope #[("main",originalText)] "main" "sign").map
  fun result => result.occurrence.header.map (·.text)).run 10000000
#eval (sourceCatalogue controlText).map fun scanned => scanned.bodies.map fun body =>
  (body.declaration.name,body.header.map (·.text))
#eval ((OrdinarySignature.readOriginalEnvelope #[("main",controlText)] "main" "sign").map
  fun result => result.occurrence.header.map (·.text)).run 10000000
end PhaseFirst.HeaderDiagnostic
